title: Correspondence with Arnauld
summary: The Discourse made flesh: the exchange with the great Jansenist, through Count Ernst von Hessen-Rheinfels, in which the metaphysics of 1686 is attacked, defended, and sharpened into the mature doctrine of substance.
sourceNote: Seed text: G. R. Montgomery's translation (Open Court) of the Leibniz–Arnauld correspondence; OCR transcription from the archive.org scan (cu31924014598829), US public domain.
editorialNote: Scanned-source OCR: minor transcription artifacts remain; editor footnotes retained inline; a correction pass is scheduled. Letters carry stable anchors §1–§N in Montgomery's order.
